title: GAP Waiver Premier 150 Starting Balance: Long First Payment Period
content:
**GAP Waiver Addenda, GAP Waiver Premier 150 claims.** A Retail Installment Contracts contract can have a long first payment period. When it does, the Premier starting balance capitalizes some of its days. The first period is the days from the contract date to the first payment date, as the contract record shows them.

| First period | Days capitalized |
|---|---|
| more than 50 days | 20 days |
| 32 to 50 days | the days beyond 30 |
| 31 days or fewer | none |

The first-period days capitalized add to the opening principal. The amount added is the amount financed times the original annual percentage rate divided by 100, times those days, divided by 365, rounded half-up to the cent.

**Boundaries:**

- a first period of 51 days capitalizes 20 days;
- 50 days capitalizes 20 days, the days beyond 30;
- 32 days capitalizes 2 days;
- 31 days capitalizes none.

*Hypothetical case.* A contract with 14000.00 financed at 21 percent has a 44-day first period. The days beyond 30 are 14. The amount added to the opening principal is 14000.00 times 21 divided by 100, times 14, divided by 365, which is 112.77.
